# Vendor Knowledge

Vendor-specific knowledge is separated from the generic PLC engineering model.

## Planned vendor modules

- Siemens TIA Portal / S7
- Rockwell Automation Studio 5000 / Logix
- Mitsubishi GX Works
- Schneider Electric EcoStruxure / Modicon

## Rule

Do not copy syntax or instruction semantics between vendors. Each vendor module must identify supported platform families, software versions, language conventions, data types, timer/counter behavior, diagnostics and known limitations.

Only documented or verified vendor behavior should be presented as fact.
